text:
Maya: hitting a blocker on the quickstart — first API call errors out even though I thought my trial credits were active
Maya: curl I'm running:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Maya: response: `{"error":"billing_required","message":"Workspace requires billing setup"}`
Maya: workspace id: wks_12345
Sam: thanks — quick check: are you on the same workspace in the console as the API key was created for? :eyes:
Maya: yes, console shows a small trial balance but no payment method attached
BillingBot: Automated alert — workspace wks_12345: trial_credits=0, payment_method=none, actions_blocked=true
Sam: ok that explains it. backend returns a 402-like billing error which the SDK normalizes to a generic error atm. we should surface this more clearly in the SDK error type (auth vs billing).
Leo: can reproduce locally — SDK shrinks this to `AuthenticationError` in node-sdk which is confusing. stack snippet:
```
Error: AuthenticationError: request failed
    at Requester._handleResponse (node_modules/redwood-sdk/index.js:120)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```
Leo: proposal: SDK should map HTTP 402 -> BillingError with .requiresPayment boolean and a help_url pointing to billing docs
Maya: for onboarding flow, blocking the very first "hello world" call feels bad. new users just see "AuthenticationError" and bounce.
Anya: agreed — support sees this weekly. we already have a doc page but it's not linked in quickstart.
Sam: short-term: document quickstart note about required payment method, update CLI quickstart to check billing status before first call. long-term: we can allow limited sandbox calls (e.g., 3k tokens) without a PM, tied to trial window. product ok? @Anya can you coordinate?
Anya: yes, I'll open an internal ticket and a GH issue for the SDK change. also will add a small CTA in quickstart to check billing/credits.
DeployBot: deploy queued: docs/quickstart -> add-billing-callout (sha: a1b2c3)
Maya: thanks — will try adding a payment method and report back.
Leo: creating SDK PR to add BillingError mapping and expose help_url; will reference issue #842
Anya: support ticket created: INT-2219, linked to GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/842
Sam: follow-ups: (1) SDK error mapping PR, (2) docs quickstart patch, (3) backend policy discussion about 1-call sandbox exemption. I'll add to our weekly devex sync agenda.
Maya: sweet, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Sam: ping me if you still see the blocking error after adding PM — we can temporarily grant a dev override.
Maya: got a success after adding PM, first call succeeded :)
Anya: marking INT-2219 as "in progress" and adding suggested copy for quickstart: "If you see a billing_required error, add a payment method or apply your trial promo in the Workspace billing page: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/wks_12345/billing"
Leo: note for engineering: please include the workspace id in the API error payload so we can point users directly to the right console page without extra hops.
Maya: yep that would help a lot."
